environment: GLIBC 2.28; Node 24; Next 16.3.8 Webpack + WASM SWC; Chrome 138.0.7204.92

build.scope: Whole frozen source, not a reduced scaffold

fullBrowser.command: pnpm exec playwright test --grep-invert 'CRM article exposes bounded evidence'
fullBrowser.scope: Full suite except the new article test; final CRM/article checks after evidence updates are recorded separately

installation.scope: Fresh separate CLI consumer typecheck, production build and browser flows; portable source/dependencies, not CRM API or a separately installed CRM application

article.command: pnpm exec playwright test tests/blog.spec.ts tests/sales-crm-blog.spec.ts tests/sales-crm.spec.ts
article.scope: Final article/evidence and unchanged CRM UI; bilingual figures, live example link, image loading, narrow layouts and CRM behavior

finalEngineering.scope: Complete frozen source with final article and evidence assets

liveDevelopment.scope: Shared development server title and example link verified separately; formal feature acceptance uses the isolated production snapshot

limits: Local fixtures and in-memory images; business data resets on reload. Only sidebar width is persisted.
No CRM API, authentication, collaboration, remote saving or unavailable destination pages.
Initials/Lucide/system fonts replace reference assets without license evidence. No pixel identity or performance benefit is claimed.

gitDelivery.note: Shared worktree received a parallel Agent board commit; this CRM task did not issue commit/push or read credentials.
